items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Killian was a high note man also... Killian was nice, very nice trumpet player. But we'd say that Cat was like a bull. He was very strong.

ctx.x: After Cat left in the forties, Al Killian (inaudible), right?
No, I think -- no, that's right, Killian was first.
Wasn't Cat there before Al, and then after, again?
